purpose: Prevent an execution turn from returning control before the bounded unit and all actual terminal invariants converge, while treating elapsed time as latency telemetry rather than completion authority.

execution.persists_until: bounded unit completed_verified plus terminal reconciliation, genuine blocker, or newer owner command

status_and_continue.persists_until: same boundary as execution after the concise status

keep_going.persists_until: owner-named boundary plus terminal reconciliation, genuine blocker, or newer owner command

get_ready.persists_until: preparation is complete; substantive implementation remains reserved

permitted_final_response_reasons: bounded unit is completed_verified, required successor selection is complete, lifecycle is closed, and execution reconciliation has no unmet invariants
a classified genuine blocker with current evidence survived reasonable recovery and blocks all authorized progress
the owner explicitly selected get_ready, status_only, or analysis_only
nonterminal_conditions: implementation exists but current exact-head validation has not passed
current exact-head validation or another required asynchronous operation is queued or running
the governed pull request remains open
merge succeeded but canonical closeout or successor selection is pending
a logical operation completed while lifecycle phase is fill or closeout
desired terminal state and observed execution state do not reconcile
an external side effect is planned/applied but not verified or compensated
a reconciliation pass made no progress and terminal liveness has not recovered
no independent passing evidence is bound to the active cycle and trace
resume generation points to a different cycle identity
operation, effect or evidence trace identity is broken
the reconciliation digest does not match the terminal evidence snapshot
anticipated response length, token pressure, context pressure, tool-call count, or self-imposed execution budget while authorized tools remain callable
the executor has enough capability to emit a final response but has not run and obeyed a fresh termination preflight

execution_reconciliation.resumed_from_cycle_id: null for uninterrupted execution; active cycle_id for resumed execution
execution_reconciliation.operation_ledger: one durable record per logical operation with unique operation_id/idempotency_key, attempts and trace_id
execution_reconciliation.side_effect_ledger: one durable record per external effect with unique effect_id/idempotency_key, terminal verified/compensated state and trace_id
execution_reconciliation.progress: reconciliation_passes >= 1; consecutive_no_progress_passes = 0 at terminal; diagnostic_mode boolean
execution_reconciliation.verification_evidence: at least one independent passing record bound to active cycle and trace
execution_reconciliation.reconciliation_digest: SHA-256 over canonical bundle JSON excluding this digest field

explicit_machine_state.rule: Open PR, active current-head validation, merged-with-closeout-pending, nonterminal lifecycle state, or any unmet reconciliation invariant independently blocks final response. Elapsed time does not.

execution_envelope_integrity.cycle_rule: One durable execution run preserves one cycle identity across logical operations and conversation/session changes.
execution_envelope_integrity.fill_rule: While phase=fill and authorized same-lane work exists, operation completion selects the next authorized operation.
execution_envelope_integrity.risk_signal_rule: The initial 16-minute value is a closeout-risk signal only; it is not a mandatory phase transition.
execution_envelope_integrity.terminal_rule: Closure requires phase=closed, closeout_complete=true and a passing reconciliation bundle. There is no minimum runtime gate.
execution_envelope_integrity.latency_rule: The initial 24-minute value is a latency SLO. Terminal state may close before or after it; an overrun is recorded as telemetry rather than used as permission to continue or stop.
execution_envelope_integrity.resume_rule: Conversation change, context compaction, operation completion or recovery does not reset cycle identity or durable run state.

execution_reconciliation_integrity.desired_state_rule: Terminal state is declared desired state plus reconciled observed state, not the executor's assertion that a sub-operation is done.
execution_reconciliation_integrity.one_pass_rule: Return the complete set of unmet invariants in one reconciliation pass and repair the set as a batch before another terminal attempt.
execution_reconciliation_integrity.operation_rule: Retries retain one operation_id/idempotency_key and increment attempts. Duplicate identities are invalid and cannot be counted as progress.
execution_reconciliation_integrity.side_effect_rule: External effects are separately identified from operations and must reach verified or compensated state before terminal response.
execution_reconciliation_integrity.liveness_rule: consecutive_no_progress_passes must be zero at terminal. Narration, polling or unchanged reruns do not reset liveness.
execution_reconciliation_integrity.verification_rule: At least one passing verification record must be independent of the executor's completion assertion and bound to the current cycle and trace.
execution_reconciliation_integrity.resume_rule: resume_generation may increase after interruption, but resumed_from_cycle_id must equal the active cycle_id.
execution_reconciliation_integrity.trace_rule: All operation, side-effect and evidence rows carry the same trace_id.
execution_reconciliation_integrity.digest_rule: The terminal bundle digest binds the exact reconciled snapshot; mutation after reconciliation invalidates the proof.

blocker_integrity.rule: A genuine blocker is an externally evidenced inability to make any remaining authorized progress, not an executor preference to stop.
forbidden_self_classifications: tool execution cut off without a concrete platform rejection
blocker_integrity.platform_usage_ceiling_rule: Only a concrete platform/tool rejection or explicit usage-ceiling signal that actually prevents all remaining authorized progress may be environment_unavailable.
blocker_integrity.callable_tool_rule: If any pending authorized closeout, merge, verification, successor or reconciliation repair step remains callable through an available governed tool or fallback, execution must continue.

runtime_enforcement.mandatory_invocation_rule: Every execution-mode final response requires a fresh preflight result. Skipping preflight is a control-plane incident.
runtime_enforcement.execution_envelope_rule: Completed logical work does not itself close the run. The termination preflight evaluates actual lifecycle closure before reconciliation.
runtime_enforcement.execution_reconciliation_rule: After lifecycle state becomes closed, termination preflight reconciles durable operation/effect/liveness/evidence/recovery/trace/digest invariants and blocks final response until the full returned unmet set is repaired.
runtime_enforcement.timing_rule: Latency values are telemetry/SLOs only and may never substitute for actual terminal invariants.
runtime_enforcement.branch_pr_collision_rule: After governed start and before application mutation, supply the fresh authorized branch/open-PR snapshot to execution_transaction_preflight.py and resume the exact authorized branch or PR when present.
runtime_enforcement.exact_head_rule: Only validation evidence whose validated head equals the current candidate head counts toward closeout.
runtime_enforcement.event_truth_rule: For ledger-backed runs, owner-interaction and latency facts are derived from the hash-chained event stream and may not be independently authored by the executor.
